answer: One defence is signed farmer subsidy claim history with agriculture department attestation: a claim history the agriculture department holds across a decade of filings, and the relic of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the spiral of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The willow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
